function.name: read_output_evidence
function.description: Read frozen final-file evidence units from the actual DOCX/PDF inventory. IDs belong to the output namespace and never grant tender-source coverage. Continue from next until total. not_checked units require page inspection and cannot be treated as approved content.

function.name: read_output_view
function.description: Read exact frozen output pixels for one image_region unit. The next request carries the actual stored image, not just its ID or text. This never grants a visual receipt for unsupported fields or text boxes. Use read_output_evidence for units without a frozen image.

function.name: read_review_obligations
function.description: Page the complete frozen obligation inventory, including chapters or templates missing entirely from the final file. This index grants no source or candidate-detail reading receipt; use inspect_analysis and original read tools independently.

function.name: put_composition_review
function.description: Review one actual output unit or one frozen tender obligation. For obligations cite the actual output_ids implementing it; an absent obligation needs a finding after inspecting the complete file inventory. The host assigns issue IDs from findings text. Unsupported parser content is not_checked, never source_limited. Source_limited requires an actual frozen source uncertainty.

findings.description: Actual issue, limitation or exclusion rationale. Required and nonempty for findings, source_limited, not_checked and not_applicable; empty for pass.

output_ids.description: Exact already-read output units implementing this obligation. Empty only for a grounded absence/limitation. Output-unit judgments default to their own ID.
